values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 5 pm on the day of arrival, online or 1-800-456-2267. 'Walk-ins will not be permitted' at DEC campgrounds. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/wilmington-notch/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=561 (banner: same-day until 5pm, 'Walk-ins will not be permitted'; 'up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; LENGTH OF STAY), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 561 (all pages, 2026-10-20): all 52 campsites 'Electric Hookup - no', 'Full Hookup - no'

values.note: DEC says 54 campsites; ReserveAmerica lists 52, all back-in. Equipment lengths where listed are 20 ft (33 sites) or 30 ft (9 sites); 10 list none. Some sites close for DEC's Campsite Restoration Project.

sites.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/wilmington-notch-campground-and-day-use-area ('54 campsites') + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 561 (all pages, 2026-10-20)

facilities.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/wilmington-notch-campground-and-day-use-area ('hot showers, flush toilets, trailer dump station, recycling center, firewood and ice sales'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed $18 + $5 non-resident (DEC page), ReserveAmerica 9-month window, 14-night max. Added same-day until 5 pm, no walk-ins, no electric (catalog), 54 sites, back-in only, lengths to 30 ft (most 20), showers/flush toilets/dump. Season left as set today from RA 2027 (May 7-Oct 10); DEC's page gives May 8-Oct 12 for 2026. Not stated: water/sewer at sites.
